title: Emerald Paradise
meta_description: Emerald Paradise is a 4BR luxe townhome in Blue Mountain Beach with rooftop terrace, pool \& beach access just 2 blocks away on scenic 30A.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to Emerald Paradise of Blue Mountain Beach! This coastal luxury townhome is conveniently located on 30A in the community of Thirty Blu. Emerald Paradise features dual living areas, an open rooftop terrace for entertaining, brand new counter tops, lighting, glasses and flatware, beach chairs, and all new furniture! This home offers 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, 3 floors, and can sleep at least 10 guests. The best part of all, you are only 2 blocks from the sugar sand beaches of the Emerald Coast! Each floor provides guests plenty of space, allowing a comfortable stay for multiple families. Gather on the rooftop to enjoy the views of the morning, or the Gulf Coast's beautiful sunsets. Emerald Paradise is the perfect home for 30A lovers to enjoy a classic, laid back, Blue Mountain Beach experience.

ABOUT THE AREA: Emerald Paradise is located across the street from the local grocery store (they make the best smoothies,) yoga, Blue Mountain Creamery, Blue Mountain Bakery, coffee, and more. Also close by is Blue Mountain's favorite -- Red Fish Taco, a casual restaurant in Redfish Village with amazing live music! The pork carnitas are a must! Visit Shunk Gulley and the local smoke house -- Blue Mabel. Blue Mountain beach, known for its blue lupin flowers, is full of natural beauty and activities for the whole family!

BEACH ACCESS:
Blue Mountain Regional Access: 0.3 miles approximately a 5 minutes . This beach has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. It's located at the end of Scenic Highway 83.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- 2 Queen beds, adjoining bath
• Bedroom 2 -- 2 Queens, adjoining bath
• Bedroom 3 - King, ensuite
• Bedroom 4 - King, ensuite

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Large Roof-top Terrace
• Community Pool -- Heated seasonally
• 2 Living Rooms
• Pack n Play
• Coffee Maker
• Communal Grill -- Propane
• Smart TVs
• Brand new countertops, lighting, outdoor furniture, rugs, décor, sofas, beach chairs, and new mesh internet
• Washer and dryer
• Full linen package
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Beach chairs may be available for guest use but are not guaranteed.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces (marked #5) and 1 overflow first come first serve visitor spot.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
